description: Source code for PHY synchronization control in a Zephyr-based simulation environment, managing timing, events, and configuration of PHY sync parameters.

methods.name: psc_program_next_event
methods.description: Schedules the next PHY sync event based on the maximum resync offset.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_event_reached
methods.description: Handles the event when PHY sync timer is reached, updates last resync time, and reschedules next event.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_init
methods.description: Initializes PHY sync control, sets last resync time, and programs the first event.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_set_last_phy_sync_time
methods.description: Sets the last synchronization time with the PHY and reschedules the next event.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_set_max_resync_offset
methods.description: Configures the maximum allowed offset for PHY resynchronization.

methods.name: tm_set_phy_max_resync_offset
methods.description: Backward compatibility function to set max resync offset.

methods.name: cmd_start_of_found
methods.description: Handles the command line argument for start offset.

methods.name: cmd_no_delay_init_found
methods.description: Handles the command line argument to disable delay init.

methods.name: cmd_no_sync_preinit_found
methods.description: Handles the command line argument to disable sync preinit.

methods.name: cmd_no_sync_preboot_found
methods.description: Handles the command line argument to disable sync preboot.

methods.name: cmd_max_resync_offset_found
methods.description: Handles the command line argument for max resync offset.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_register_args
methods.description: Registers command line arguments for PHY sync configuration.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_connect_to_2G4_phy
methods.description: Connects the simulation to a 2.4 GHz PHY device.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_pre_boot2
methods.description: Pre-boot setup, waits for simulation time if needed.

methods.name: phy_sync_ctrl_pre_boot3
methods.description: Post-boot setup, syncs with PHY if required.
